Save fidelity pass. Crafting stations persist time_left and restore it without clobbering wait_time (Timer.start(t) assigns the interval). New test/unit/test_save_fidelity.gd covers the loss class; verified at runtime with a station saved mid-item and real pre-change pickups.

PlayerGather.enter() now returns early when a gather is already running, so repeat presses (cheap on touch, where the joystick emits a drag every frame) no longer restart hold_timer; animation_finished ignores animations that finish while another state is current, which had been yanking the player to Idle after every attack. The chest/station interact highlight owns its own tracked cell instead of wiping all of layer 3, so it no longer hides the gather selector, and freed chests are dropped from the list before their position is read. EnemyFollow guards its connect and disconnects in exit(). set_tile_item uses atlas_location rather than the inventory icon cell. Enemies join an Enemy group and mobile_controls reads that instead of filtering SaveLoad. use_slot_data consults can_use() for every item, spending a charge only for consumables.
